notes.title: Announcement 6/7/2022
notes.content:
After a long development, Acorn City is finally nearing it's completion. However, it is taking slightly longer than initially anticipated. Acorn City will be delayed until 6/11/2022 at the earliest. We apologize for the wait and have provided early access keys below for anybody to try the game before release. Thank you for sticking with us, happy building.
- Sean-Paul Divincenzo, Divine Games.

notes.title: Patch Notes 6/6/2022
notes.content:
EDIT: 6/6/2022 12:27PM
A hotfix has been implemented to resolve a missing crafting table issue, if you're experiencing this update your game and delete your save games (Island and Player saves MUST be deleted together or the game may stop working. Save files are located in the \Acorn City Tropical!\AcornCity\Saved\SaveGames

Version 0.8 has been released

[list]
[*]Adjusted Tool Menu
[*]Added Delete Tool
[*]Added Placeholder for Path Tool
[*]Added tutorial
[*]Inventory now saves
[*]Visual improvements
[*]Character Creation
[*]Trees and rocks should now become "empty" and should recharge at 3AM the following day.
[/list]

If you find any bugs please feel free to post them in our discord server, that's the fastest way to report bugs at this time.

[url=https://discord.gg/zg6Zh2h]https://discord.gg/zg6Zh2h[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 5/6/2022
notes.content:
Hotfix 0.7.5 implemented.
[list]
[*]Bug fixes with Island Saving
[*]First stage of Progression implemented, more stages coming soon
[*]Additional Bug Fixes
[/list]

0.8 will be coming soon and will feature inventory saving, a tutorial, and additional progression.
